name: portal-os-v1
description: Portal-OS v1 - Foundation OS deployed on Cloudflare Pages/Workers

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:static
scripts.build:static: mkdir -p dist && cp src/index.html dist/index.html 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name portal-os-v1

author: maxjurreau
